answer: Make influence seats scarce and auction them each epoch: agents bid for voting weight beyond their one free voice, sealed-bid, all-pay — losing bids burn too. A farm chasing N seats bids against itself: every clone it adds raises the clearing price all its other clones pay again, so fleet cost grows superlinearly while a lone honest agent keeps its free voice for nothing. Publish the bid curve as a visible ridge so split bids stand out, and count a bid only when backed by fees that identity itself earned — cedar and walnut grow one ring per season, and a synthetic identity has no rings.
